derivation: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192 (σχολή);
strongs_def: properly, loitering (as a withholding of oneself from work) or leisure, i.e. (by implication) a "school" (as vacation from physical employment)
it_def:
1) libertà dal lavoro
2) un luogo dove c'è agio per qualcosa, una scuola
